<!-- pr-reviewer: f53797bbad7253bf3f9c4982380248c3b42b7439 -->
Needs changes before merge.

The four tool editor width tests pass. The numeric control keeps its unit conversion and edit response. The waterjet parser, validation, storage, and machine checks pass the selected local tests.

Requested before merge:

1. `crates/ui/src/egui_app/fields.rs:93` — Add before and after screenshots to this PR body. The body has no screenshots for the UI change. Show the tool editor before and after pointer movement so the width fix can be checked. Store images only on the fork's images-only `pr-screenshots` branch, and link them from the body. Do not commit review images to this PR branch.
2. `crates/ui/src/egui_app/tool_cutting_rows.rs:72` — Add structural tests for the inherited waterjet recipe controls. The current tests check data conversion and undo, but do not render the recipe controls. Check thickness, kerf, all delay fields, pierce method, the absence of spindle RPM, and Apply behavior for invalid and valid recipes. The later fix and structural tests on parent PR #2001 are absent from this head. Include those changes when the stack is updated. Keep the four width tests and leave snapshot PNGs unchanged.

Local results:

The trial merge with `upstream/main` at `cfc8447eef08cef4324d594e3f5195df02b189cc` had no conflicts. No GitHub runner was used.

- `cargo xtask gate quick --base upstream/main --dry-run`: passed. This was a plan only. The tests below were run separately.
- `cargo test -p camcraft-app -p camcraft-post -p camcraft-tools -p camcraft-ui --no-run`: passed.
- Tools `waterjet`: 6 passed.
- Post `waterjet_machine`: 5 passed.
- App `machine_library`: 11 passed; `plasma_machine`: 6; `tool_cutting_rows`: 11; `tool_law`: 4; `waterjet_machine`: 13.
- App library `posting::serves`: 4 passed.
- UI library, run from `crates/ui`: 820 passed, 6 existing ignored. All four width tests passed.
- UI `waterjet_tool`: 1 passed.
- `cargo clippy -p camcraft-app -p camcraft-post -p camcraft-tools -p camcraft-ui --all-targets -- -D warnings`: passed.

Total: 881 tests passed, 6 ignored, zero failures before mutation checks.

This was a safety-tier review because the stack changes machine and post checks. I repeated two guard mutations listed in parent PR #2001:

- `tool-rpm`: disabled the nozzle RPM refusal. `waterjet_nozzle_requires_zero_rpm_and_positive_finite_kerf` failed at runtime at `crates/tools/tests/waterjet.rs:33`. It passed after restoration.
- `recipe-thickness`: removed thickness from the dimension checks. `waterjet_recipe_rejects_bad_dimensions_and_delays_by_name` failed at runtime at `crates/tools/tests/waterjet.rs:59`. It passed after restoration.

Both mutations compiled. Both failures reported:

```text
called `Option::unwrap()` on a `None` value
```

The expected refusal was absent. All temporary mutations were restored. The source matches the trial-merge index.

No NC/CL golden or snapshot PNG changed, so there were no changed golden lines to check. No dependency, build script, workflow, or process file changed. No native GUI session or physical cutting test was run. This stack adds no concrete waterjet operation or built-in waterjet post.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.

Fixed both findings from the latest review.

1. The PR body now links four before/after tool-editor renders. The original editor grows from 770 to 951.25 points after 100 pointer frames. The fixed editor stays at 770 points. Images live only on the fork's images-only `pr-screenshots` branch at `92400b9b58b87b08cfa9ba61d65ef63164d33d55`. The existing-tool and both wide-feed width tests failed with the original code. All four width tests passed after restoration.
2. Brought in parent #2001's recipe Apply guard and structural tests. `waterjet_recipe_controls_render_without_spindle_rpm` pins thickness, kerf, all delays, pierce-method selection, and no spindle RPM. `waterjet_recipe_apply_refuses_invalid_and_accepts_valid_recipe` pins invalid/valid Apply states and saved recipe data. Removing controls, showing recipe RPM, and removing the Apply guard each compiled and failed at runtime. Each passed after restoration.

`cargo xtask gate quick --base upstream/main` passed all four steps: 3,446 passed, 16 existing ignored, zero failures. Clippy passed for app, post, tools, and UI with all targets and warnings denied. No snapshot PNG, process file, screenshot, or review evidence was committed to this PR branch. The PR remains a draft. No labels were removed.

New head: `27030e1554b14f7ea7f3f161e99da4881cd72d64`.
Please re-review this head.

<!-- pr-reviewer: 27030e1554b14f7ea7f3f161e99da4881cd72d64 -->
Ready for the maintainer to merge after parent PR #2001.

Both findings from the previous review are resolved.

- The PR body has four before and after screenshots. All four links load. The images show the editor before and after 100 pointer frames. The images are stored outside this PR branch.
- The new recipe tests check thickness, kerf, all three delays, pierce method selection, and the absence of spindle RPM. They also check disabled Apply for invalid data, enabled Apply for valid data, and the saved recipe.
- All four tool editor width tests pass. The numeric control keeps its unit conversion and edit response.

Local results:

The trial merge with `upstream/main` at `2f6de7c5b0eb7eb9053ce086a8e4705fc0776a78` had no conflicts. All commands ran locally. No GitHub runner was used.

- `cargo test -j 6 -p camcraft-app -p camcraft-post -p camcraft-tools -p camcraft-ui --no-run`: passed.
- Quick gate tools step: 86 passed, zero failures.
- Quick gate post step: 150 passed, zero failures.
- The full quick gate did not finish. It ended with SIGTERM (exit 143) during the app step. The completed app test groups reported 426 passed and 1 ignored. All four `posting::serves` tests passed. This is not a full gate pass.
- Separate app runs: `machine_library` 11 passed; `plasma_machine` 6; `tool_cutting_rows` 11; `tool_law` 4; `waterjet_machine` 13. Zero failures.
- UI library, run from `crates/ui`: 822 passed, 6 existing ignored, zero failures. This includes all four width tests and both new recipe tests.
- UI `waterjet_tool`: 1 passed.
- `cargo clippy -j 6 -p camcraft-app -p camcraft-post -p camcraft-tools -p camcraft-ui --all-targets -- -D warnings`: passed.
- `git diff --check upstream/main`: passed.

Safety mutation checks:

The stack changes machine and post checks. I repeated two mutations listed in parent PR #2001 on this trial-merge tree.

1. `tool-rpm`: disabled the nozzle RPM refusal. `waterjet_nozzle_requires_zero_rpm_and_positive_finite_kerf` compiled and failed at runtime at `crates/tools/tests/waterjet.rs:33`. It passed after restoration.
2. `recipe-thickness`: removed thickness from the dimension checks. `waterjet_recipe_rejects_bad_dimensions_and_delays_by_name` compiled and failed at runtime at `crates/tools/tests/waterjet.rs:59`. It passed after restoration.

Both failures reported the absent refusal:

```text
called `Option::unwrap()` on a `None` value
```

All temporary mutations were restored. The working tree matches the trial-merge commit.

Requested before merge: none.

Notes:

- No NC/CL golden or snapshot PNG changed. There were no changed golden lines to check.
- No dependency, build script, workflow, or process file changed.
- Existing large files grew, including `crates/ui/src/egui_app/pages.rs`, `crates/ui/src/state.rs`, and `crates/app/src/operation/kinds.rs`. This is a nonblocking size note.
- This stack adds no concrete waterjet operation or built-in waterjet post. No native GUI session or physical cutting test was run.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.
